about: schema 1: one entry per registry block (sorted by name), one line per valid block state (sorted by properties); props = state property values; boxes = entity-vs-block collision boxes for this state in isolation (air neighbours, no entity), relative to the block origin, [minX,minY,minZ,maxX,maxY,maxZ]; slipperiness = Block.slipperiness as a raw float; climbable = Block.isLadder. File is UTF-8 with LF line endings.
